**Drawback** You gain the [Encumbered](/condition/encumbered-player-core) condition and can't remove it while under the effects of the mutagen.

name: Effect: Energizing Lattice
descr:
Granted by [Energizing Lattice](/item/energizing-lattice-treasure-vault-remastered)

The latticework glows for 1 minute, shedding bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light for the next 20 feet). You can Dismiss this light.

**Activate** 2 envision (force)

**Requirements** The *energizing lattice* is glowing because it negated an enemy's critical hit

---

**Effect** You release the lattice's energy and make a weapon or unarmed attack Strike that deals 6d6 additional force damage. If your Strike fails, but doesn't critically fail, the target still takes half the force damage. The latticework ceases glowing after the Strike.

name: Effect: Instinct Crown
descr:
Granted by [Instinct Crown (Animal)](/item/instinct-crown-animal-treasure-vault-remastered), [Instinct Crown (Dragon)](/item/instinct-crown-dragon-treasure-vault-remastered), [Instinct Crown (Giant)](/item/instinct-crown-giant-treasure-vault-remastered), [Instinct Crown (Spirit)](/item/instinct-crown-spirit-treasure-vault-remastered), [Instinct Crown (Superstition)](/item/instinct-crown-superstition-treasure-vault-remastered)

You gain a benefit depending on the instinct the crown is tied to

**Animal** You gain 10 additional temporary Hit Points. You deal 3 additional damage with your animal's unarmed attacks, and those unarmed attacks gain the [deadly d8](/trait/deadly) trait.**Fury** You become Quickened. You deal 2 additional damage when using your larger weapon.**Spirit** Your raging resistance applies to all physical damage and poison damage.
